payload.comment: Abstention report is internally consistent: abstain_rate + test_coverage = 1.0 (0.241226 + 0.758774); selective_risk = 1 − accuracy_on_covered (0.133443); human_review_count (1732) matches abstain_rate × test_size (0.241226 × 7180 ≈ 1732); validation_coverage (0.80008) aligns with target (0.8); base_test_accuracy (0.780223) < accuracy_on_covered (0.866557) as expected for selective prediction. Threshold calibration on validation is standard. No deterministic findings exist. Cross-stage artefacts (ingestion, preprocessing, profiling, experiment_design, evaluation) are mutually consistent in split sizes, class counts, and provenance. One observation: ood_auroc = 0.259561 is below 0.5, indicating max_softmax confidence is anti-informative for the specific unit-scale Gaussian noise (σ=0.25) OD
